pr_title: Fix up nullability and form schema handling in OpenAPI
pr_body:
Closes #56903.

Mark all parameters sourced from the query, header, route, and form from being marked as nullable.

Cloes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/57082.

Attributes on the parameter associated with a `[FromForm]` attribute now get applied correctly because we pass in `ApiParameterDescription` when we generate the schema.

Addresses https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/57083.

Remove the `encoding` field on form parameters until we figure out the correct values to set.

issue_context.title: Schemas for parameters should not specify `nullable: true`
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

The OpenAPI document generation support in .NET 9 preview 6 will produce parameter schemas with `nullable: true` if the endpoint parameter is a nullable type (either value or reference). This is incorrect because passing "null" for a query or header or route parameter does not set the parameter to `null` but rather sets it to the string "null".

### Expected Behavior

Don't specify `nullable: true` in the schema of query, header, or route parameters.

### Steps To Reproduce

Not minimal, but easy. Clone my [aspnet-openapi-examples]() project and run `dotnet build`, then look at the "q", "myCustomHeader", and "maybeValue" parameters for the Post on "/operations/{id}/parameters".

### Exceptions (if any)

_No response_

### .NET Version

9.0.100-preview.7.24365.15

### Anything else?

_No response_
